review_description: I had solar panels installed by Solar Run Keysborough, and I couldn’t be happier with the entire experience. From the initial consultation to the final installation, their team was professional, knowledgeable, and incredibly easy to work with.They took the time to explain every step of the process, answered all my questions, and helped me choose the right system for my home.I truly appreciate the quality of their work and the ongoing support they've provided post-installation.

We had a great experience with the installer. Starting from the quote to helping us with the rebate application, it was a smooth process. They planned and installed as promised and did a great overall job.

Dilan helped decide on the panels and the inverter and the system size to suit our consumption. He advised the optimum solution (provided his professional recommendation for placing of the panels & the inverter). Team was professional, friendly, cooperative and patient with all our questions, as we didn't know much about the process. They guided us on the documentation for the rebates and loan and did all of these for us. Exceptional !!!

The entire process from the basic questions to the more in depth as the information sunk in, to great and quick communication to the install and finished product. Even after installation, they were very happy to explain our questions.Would highly recommend Solar Run Keysborough to anyone and have had many friends utilize their amazing service and products.

Solar Run Keysborough installed solar at our house this year and we had a great seamless experience from start to finish.Through the process we were provided support and kept informed and we are very happy with the result!
